# Recreation Prompt

Recreate **Glowling Family: Memory Merge** as a browser-native mobile portrait merge puzzle. Preserve the source mechanics exactly: an infinite bottom inventory offers numbered values 1-4; the player drags a piece from inventory or the board; releasing near a same-number piece merges the target upward by one; unmatched board drops snap to a half-grid and clamp inside the board; dropping near the inventory deletes/returns the active item; reset clears all pieces; value 7 unlocks a rainbow-like celebration; value 10 is the soft aspirational cap.

Theme the game as a Pixar-like emotional adventure without using protected movie IP. The focal actors are rounded expressive **Glowlings**, numbered companions with eyes, smiles, blush, and warm personality colors. The world is a soft cinematic memory valley with golden light, drifting clouds, lantern props, heart/star particles, and storybook HUD panels. HUD terms should remain mechanically clear: “Drag matching Glowlings together,” “Togetherness,” and “Biggest memory.” Optimize for portrait viewports from 4:7 to 9:16 with large touch targets, readable copy, an accessible start button, and non-blocking feedback.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source game truth
The preserved source (`index_old.html`) is a mobile-friendly canvas merge puzzle. The player starts the game, drags numbered character blocks from an infinite bottom inventory containing values 1, 2, 3, and 4, places them on the board, and merges two same-number blocks by dropping one near the other. A successful merge increments the target block by one up to 10. There is no hard timer, damage, loss state, or formal win screen; progression is expressed through higher values and a rainbow/spectacle unlock at value 7. Reset clears the board.

## Protected mechanics
- Pointer/touch drag from inventory and already placed pieces.
- Infinite source inventory of values 1-4.
- Same-ID proximity merge on release using the original threshold style (`distance < gridBase * 0.6`).
- Merge increments target by exactly one and does not merge value 10 further.
- Non-merged drops snap to a half-grid and clamp inside the board.
- Dropping near the inventory deletes/returns the active item.
- Reset clears placed pieces and resets the spectacle mode.
- Canvas animation loop and particle feedback remain lightweight and continuous.

## Remix trajectory
The public rebuild is **Glowling Family: Memory Merge**, a Pixar-like emotional adventure where numbered companions represent feeling memories. The loop is reinterpreted as guiding matching Glowlings into hugs so they become bigger family memories. The scene, HUD, feedback, particles, typography, start screen, and character silhouettes were rebuilt to support soft cinematic lighting, expressive characters, heartwarming comedy, family-friendly spectacle, and portrait-first mobile readability.

## Safe theming surfaces
HUD copy, title, character drawing style, background art, particle shapes, feedback GIF placement, audio mood, start overlay, color roles, progression language, and instruction text are presentation-level surfaces and are safe to transform while preserving the loop.

## Complexity profile
This is a simple arcade/puzzle merge toy with light spatial placement. Complexity is not level-file based; it comes from managing board space, choosing matching values, and pursuing higher numbers. Safe escalation is visual/progression-facing: warmer feedback, bigger memory labels, rainbow unlock at 7, and aspirational Home 10 language.
